verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)g ga(n)g mil sree gur saagar mile giaan dhiaan param nidhaan livaleen hai ||

en.bdb: A Sikh ever in attendance of Satguru merges in the ocean-like True Guru through the Ganges-like holy congregation. He remains engrossed in the fountain-head of Cyan (knowledge) and contemplation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਗਤਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਚਕੋਰ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਸ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh madhukar gat cha(n)dhramaa chakor gur dhiaan ras bheen hai ||

en.bdb: A True Sikh remains absorbed and immersed in the holy dust of the True Guru like a bumble bee and longs for a glimpse of his Guru just as a moon bird experiences pangs of separation of his beloved moon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਹਾਰ ਹੰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat mukataahal ahaar ha(n)s prem paramaarath bimal jal meen hai ||

en.bdb: Like a swan whose diet is pearls, a true Sikh relishes the pearl-like Naam as his life support. Like a fish, he swims in the cool, clean and comforting waters of spirituality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮਿਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਅਮਰਾਪਦ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ  ਕਮਲਾ ਕਲਪਤਰੁ ਕਾਮਧੈਨਾਧੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੯੭॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)mit kaTaachh amaraapadh kirapaa kirapaal  kamalaa kalapatar kaamadhainaadheen hai ||97||

en.bdb: By the element and nectar-like glimpse of grace of the True Guru, a true Sikh attains immortality. And then all mythical donors like Kamdhen cow or Kalap brichh and even Lakshmi (Goddess of wealth) serve him diligently. (97)
